_status: READ-ONLY durable live-habitat collector plus the prospective L5 full-L2 recorder. Public GETs only: no credential reader, no signer, no order transport, no arming flag. The image copies exactly two modules and tests/test_habitat_image_isolation.py fails if either grows a non-stdlib or off-copy-list import, a non-GET request, or an authorization constant. Streams: pmus_books, pmus_flow, intl_books, intl_flow, and prospective/ (events.jsonl never rotates; raw firehoses rotate at 3 GB and shed below a 2 GB free-space floor). Nothing here is submitted, filled, settled or realized.
_why_this_file_exists: deploy/l5_live_habitat was the only Dockerfile directory in this repo with no manifest, which tests/test_deploy_fallthrough_guard.py flags as a fall-through risk: a service without an explicit startCommand is how a config-less service once ran the order-capable Kalshi bot. Railway reads its config from the service root, not from here, so this file pins the intent in the repo rather than driving the build.
